content:
DESC:
OSS-Fuzz issue 42504982 (espeak-ng): Stack-buffer-overflow READ 1 found by fuzz target ssml-fuzzer [asan]. https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/42504982

BUILD:
export ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0
./autogen.sh
./configure --with-libfuzzer=yes --disable-shared --with-speechplayer=no
make check || true
cp tests/ssml-fuzzer.test $OUT/ssml-fuzzer
cp -r espeak-ng-data/ $OUT/
